# ARH Digital (ARH Design)

> ARH Digital is a small web design studio in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. It builds bold, fast, conversion-focused websites for local businesses in Jeddah and beyond. The site is available in English, Arabic, French and Hindi.

Everything below comes from the public pages of https://arhdesign.tech. Prices are in US dollars. Domain renewal is included only while an active ARH support relationship covers it; premium domains and major redesigns are quoted separately.

## Services

- Web design: distinctive interfaces that make a business look established, trustworthy and memorable.
- Development: fast, responsive builds that work on phones, tablets and desktops.
- SEO foundations: clean technical foundations that help local customers find and understand the business.
- Support: reasonable updates and practical support after launch, with larger work quoted clearly.

## Pricing

Two ways to pay: monthly support or a one-time build.

- Essential: $26 per month, or $99 one-time. Professional starter website.
- Pro: $40 per month, or $209 one-time. Higher-detail website direction with a conversion-focused content structure.
- Custom: by inquiry only (no fixed price). Advanced website direction scoped and quoted first.

Promo codes are reviewed manually and confirmed in the reply; no automatic discount is shown on the site.
